name: MicMic
_backup_hotkey_note: The talk key that needs no macOS permission (a Carbon hot key, native/listener.py), registered always, beside the right-hand talk key that needs Accessibility. A combination with a modifier, e.g. "ctrl+opt+m" (the default, M for MicMic) or "ctrl+opt+k". Not ctrl+opt+space: macOS switches keyboard languages with it; "off" turns it off.

llm.note: auto means: use it when GEMINI_API_KEY exists, otherwise fall back to the keyless path. Set to false to never use it. Only two jobs go here: splitting compound requests, and answering knowledge questions. The clock and the weather never do.

_activation_note: push = press the orb or the spacebar. wake = always listening, acts only after a wake word. always = acts on everything it hears.
_voice_note: Per language, the voices to try in order (savta/voice.py): eleven_turbo = ElevenLabs v4 Turbo through MicMic's cloud (or ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in a source build), kokoro = the voice on this Mac, used ONLY if she downloaded it in Settings > Voice (English only; skipped otherwise, so English is [eleven_turbo, say] for a new user), say = macOS. To put English back on Kokoro first: "english": ["kokoro", "say"].
_contacts_note: Contacts come from WhatsApp and fall back to the macOS Contacts app. Put a name in pinned_contacts only to force it to the top of the shortlist.
